notes: Single quiet, day-grouped agenda column maintained at all three widths — one scannable list, no dashboard grid, no competing panels; at 900px the column visibly caps near 640px with empty margin on either side, matching DESIGN.md.
No horizontal overflow or edge-clipped rows spotted at 375px or 393px across the captured agenda (today through 8. november) — the narrowest width, most prone to breaking, held up.

Match names render as complete two-sided fixtures with no visible truncation/ellipsis — e.g. 'Chelsea – Manchester United', 'Bayern München – Borussia Dortmund', 'Tottenham Hotspur – Crystal Palace', Eliteserien fixtures, and Norwegian club names throughout.

Header (wordmark + search/filter controls + theme toggle), bold day headings ('I MORGEN', dated ranges through 8. november), and footer/'Dette dekker vi' disclosure block are all present and aligned at every width.
Team crests/flags render as small filled icons, not broken-image placeholders, in every row checked.
Must-see accent dots (orange/red) appear on a minority of rows only, not on every row — consistent with the 'gentlest possible emphasis' rule.

Desktop (900px): the floating 'Assistent' button sits over a mid-agenda row (around the 25. oktober / Barcelona – Atletico section), not the last agenda row or the footer — matches the DESIGN.md-sanctioned floating-button idiom (WP-146 variant D); correctly not flagged as a bug.
